ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-03-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Judge: Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Yvonne Lee.
Petitioner: Bachubhai Kuberbhai Amin, present in pro per and with Manish Patel: Gujarati Interpreter, was sworn and examined.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to: Ghanshyam Manibhai Patel.
Decree signed in open court.
